jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Data
jobs.description:
At BuildOps, we build software for modern commercial contractors, from service management through project delivery. We care deeply about the mission and look for people who are driven, self motivated, and excited by fast moving, high ownership environments.



Data sits at the center of BuildOps' AI first strategy. The operational data our customers generate on BuildOps is a long term advantage, but only if it is clean, reliable, and well governed. As Director of Engineering, Data, you will build and lead our unified Data \& AI engineering function. You will own the platforms, pipelines, quality standards, and operating discipline that power AI and ML products and help customers trust BuildOps as their system of record.



Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you will help define BuildOps' data strategy over the next three to five years and shape how we build data powered products. This is a foundational leadership role for someone who can think long term about architecture while staying close to the work. You have built and scaled data organizations before and know how to take a team from early stage scrappiness to operational excellence.


**What You'll Do**


* Own BuildOps' data platform and architecture end to end, including ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and an ML and streaming strategy that evolves with the business and scales efficiently
* Build scalable, repeatable customer and partner data onboarding capabilities that bring data into BuildOps quickly and reliably, reducing time to first value
* Run data systems with production grade discipline, including monitoring, alerting, SLAs, incident response, lineage, freshness, and clear ownership for critical datasets
* Create the data foundation required for AI and ML products, with accurate, well documented inputs today and the right training, inference, and feature infrastructure as those products mature
* Establish governance that supports speed, including access controls, data classification, audit trails, PII handling, and practical data contracts that teams can depend on
* Hire, develop, and lead a strong data engineering team, and establish the right operating rhythms across planning, on call, and stakeholder intake


**What We Look For**


* 10\+ years in data or software engineering, including experience building and scaling teams of 10\+ engineers, with a track record of hiring well, growing leaders, and leading through managers as well as individual contributors
* Deep hands on experience with modern data platforms, including a cloud warehouse or lakehouse such as Snowflake or Databricks, dbt and ELT patterns, orchestration tools like Airflow, and streaming technologies such as Kafka or Kinesis, with AWS experience strongly preferred
* Direct experience building data systems that support production ML use cases, not just analytics, with an understanding of feature stores, training data, real time inference, and the tradeoffs involved in building versus buying ML platform capabilities
* A track record of operational excellence in data, including monitoring, SLAs, incident response, and data quality practices applied with the same rigor as customer facing systems
* Experience delivering customer facing data products such as reporting, analytics, or APIs in B2B SaaS environments where performance, reliability, and trust matter
* Strong architectural judgment, including when to build, when to buy, how to design for change, and how to sequence investments behind validated needs instead of overbuilding
* A pragmatic approach to governance, with security and compliance built in, documentation and contracts that stay current, and access models that balance control with self service
* Early stage or scale up experience in Series B through D companies is a plus, and experience in vertical SaaS or construction tech is helpful but not required


**Who You Are**


* A builder who is comfortable with ambiguity and greenfield work, and can move quickly, ship an MVP, and still make sound decisions for long term scale
* Both hands on and strategic, willing to write code, debug issues, and carry operational responsibility when needed while maintaining a clear multi year vision
* You know how to influence across Product, Engineering, GTM, Finance, and the executive team, build trust, communicate clearly, and push back when priorities are misaligned
* Able to translate technical decisions into business impact and business goals into technical direction
* You have seen this stage of growth before and know what good looks like in a high growth data organization


**Compensation**


* $176,000 \- $235,000 base salary range \+ annual bonus \+ meaningful equity

**What we offer:**
* Generous equity grant, become an owner in our company!
* A comprehensive benefits package
* Flexible PTO and hybrid work schedules
* One\-time work\-from\-home allowance
* Hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, Toronto, and Raleigh with hybrid work schedules and lunch provided for in\-office days
* Company events and team\-building activities, both in\-person and virtual
* Fast\-paced, collaborative, and dynamic work environment
* Opportunities for growth and career advancement
* Chance to work with cutting\-edge technology and innovative solutions
* The chance to get in on the ground floor and build something truly groundbreaking for ourselves and our amazing customers


*We welcome applicants from across the U.S. where we are registered to do business and able to support employment. Currently, this excludes the following states: Alaska, Hawaii, Kentucky, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, North Dakota, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, and Wyoming. This list is based solely on operational and compliance considerations and is reviewed from time to time as our footprint grows.*

jobs.description:
Job Summary:


**WHO ARE WE?**

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media \& Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40\+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media \& Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com .  



**WHO ARE YOU?**

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!  



**THE ROLE**

Reporting to the Vice President, Operations Finance, the Senior Director, Operations Finance owns operational accounting for Live Nation Canada. This is the senior operating leader of a function that accounts for every show, venue and festival we run in this country; tens of thousands of transactions a year, settled under contract in a fast\-paced environment where the work is visible and the stakes are real.  



  

The Senior Director’s mission will be to elevate the function by building a high\-performing team and setting standards nationally for how shows and venues are accounted for. They will be responsible to evolve current processes toward greater automation, control and scale. Success in the first 12 months will be clear and measurable: a functioning management layer that consistently delivers on deadlines; a faster, cleaner close with a defensible timetable and fewer post\-close adjustments; one written national process standard in use across all markets; an automated end\-to\-end workflow that is live, adopted and measurably reducing manual effort or error; and a strong control environment where audit findings are closed promptly and none repeat. Working in close partnership with the Vice President, the Senior Director will help shape the direction and priorities of the function. They will be the trusted go\-to partner for the business on all matters of operational accounting.  



  

This is a great opportunity to own a national function, build a team around it, and elevate how Live Nation Canada does its accounting.  



  

**WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO**

**Leadership**

* Own the structure, capability and performance of a \~12\-person operational accounting team spanning show settlement, venue accounting and financial close
* Lead through managers: develop the management layer, set clear ownership accountabilities, establish performance standards and hold managers accountable for their teams' deadlines and quality
Own talent strategy for the function: hiring standards, onboarding, development plans, succession depth, and a coverage model that holds through peak season, festival periods and major tours  
* 

  

**Event Reporting and Operational Accounting**

* Accountable for the completeness, accuracy and timeliness of all events, venues and festivals accounting nationally (including the integrity of reported contribution margin by show, venue and market)
* Own the close calendar end to end and commit to the timetable; ensure corporate reporting deadlines are consistently met
* Own the accounting treatment of show settlement: from artist final settlements against contract, withholding tax, charity and merchandise/bundle recognition, co\-promoted events, joint venture splits, venue expense settlement and shared ancillary revenue
* Own accounting for owned and operated venues, including inventory, labour costs and cash handling
* Own balance sheet integrity for the function: reconciliation quality, accrual adequacy, deferred revenue, AR aging and collections performance for event\-related balances
* Develop and recommend accounting positions on complex deal structures such as co\-promoted events, joint ventures, festival vehicles, rental versus promoted, international artist withholding, multi\-year ancillary agreements
* Partner with regional controllers to ensure consistent application of policy across markets, and resolve differences rather than reporting them
* Partner with VP, Operational Accounting and Corporate for all technical accounting approval
* Accountable for the day\-to\-day operation of internal controls over settlement, cash floats, AP approval and wire release, including SOX\-relevant controls in scope
* Play a critical role in internal and external audits; owning remediation of findings to closure while ensuring every settlement is audit\-ready with proper documentation backup
Proactively identify control gaps as volume, venues and deal structures change, and implement corrective action  
* 

  

**National Responsibilities**

* Develop, implement and sustain a national operational accounting playbook: settlement process, documentation standards, close process and checklist, reconciliation methodology, escalation path.
* Identify and improve workstreams end to end; from business case through delivery to adoption and measured benefit
* Define and report the function's operating metrics: days to close, settlement cycle time, restatement and error rates, aged AR, control exception volume. Use them to drive decisions and continuous improvement
Own the data standards that allow event economics to be reported consistently  
*

* Collaborate effectively with divisional and global stakeholders in Technology and Information Risk Management

jobs.title: Director, Treasury Finance
jobs.description:
The primary responsibility of the Director is to lead Treasury Finance activities relating to corporate finance strategy, funding strategy, capital structure management, liability management, banking relationships, and capital markets execution. The Director serves as a key advisor to Treasury leadership and business partners on matters relating to funding, leverage, capital deployment, liquidity resources, and balance sheet optimization.

  

  

The role is accountable for developing and executing funding strategies that support Manulife's financial objectives while maintaining appropriate financial flexibility, regulatory capital levels, liquidity resources, and access to global capital markets. You will also be responsible for maintaining strong relationships with banking partners, investors, rating agencies, and advisors, while ensuring treasury financing activities are executed efficiently, effectively, and in accordance with approved governance frameworks.

  

  

**Position Responsibilities:**


* Act as Treasury Finance advisor with an overall mandate to support Treasury leadership, Capital Management, Investor Relations, Treasury Operations, Manulife Bank and other stakeholders through strategic analysis, funding recommendations, and corporate finance expertise.
* Develop recommendations regarding capital structure, leverage, funding strategy, refinancing, capital deployment, and balance sheet optimization to support the Company's financial objectives.
* Lead the development and ongoing assessment of funding strategies, incorporating market conditions, regulatory and rating agency considerations, funding requirements, investor demand, and competitive developments.
* Serve as the primary Treasury Finance lead for debt issuances, liability management transactions, wholesale funding programs, share repurchase initiatives, and other treasury\-related financing activities, including strategy, analysis, execution and post\-transaction review.
* Lead and manage Treasury\-owned banking relationships, including revolving credit facilities, letters of credit and other financing arrangements, and negotiate pricing, terms, capacity, documentation and service levels.
* Lead complex commercial negotiations with banking partners, dealers, investors, legal counsel and other external stakeholders. Review, analyze and negotiate credit agreements, underwriting agreements, term sheets, offering documents, trust indentures and other financing\-related documentation.
* Support and influence strategic decision\-making through the preparation of financial analysis, funding plans, capital structure assessments, Board materials, executive presentations and other management reporting.
* Lead strategic initiatives impacting Treasury Finance, including evaluating alternatives, assessing risks and opportunities, coordinating stakeholders and supporting implementation.
* Maintain relationships with banking partners, fixed income investors, rating agencies and other market participants to monitor trends, identify opportunities and support continued access to capital.
* Ensure funding instruments remain compliant with contractual, regulatory, reporting and governance requirements, including ongoing monitoring of covenants, obligations and maturity profiles.
* Identify and implement process improvements related to treasury strategy, funding activities, governance, reporting, controls and transaction execution.
* Responsible for coaching, mentoring and development of staff supporting Treasury Finance activities.
  

  

**Required Qualifications:**


* Post\-secondary education in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related discipline and/or a minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in treasury, corporate finance, capital markets, commercial banking, investment banking, insurance finance or a related field.
* Strong knowledge of corporate finance, capital structure management, leverage analysis, capital allocation, liquidity management and balance sheet optimization.
* Strong understanding of debt and equity capital markets, funding strategies, banking products, credit facilities and liability management activities.
* Experience executing complex financing transactions and negotiating commercial arrangements with financial institutions and other counterparties.
* Ability to review, understand and negotiate financing documentation, including credit agreements, underwriting agreements, term sheets, offering documents and related contracts.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to evaluate strategic alternatives and develop actionable recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Thorough understanding of risk management, governance and controls as they relate to treasury and financing activities.
* Excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills, including the ability to work effectively with senior management and executive stakeholders.
* Strong project management, organizational and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Demonstrated leadership capabilities with experience managing change, developing talent and fostering high\-performing teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work under pressure and adapt to changing business requirements.
* Capital markets, commercial banking, investment banking, treasury or corporate finance experience within a financial institution is considered a strong asset.
  

  

***When you join our team:***


* We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want
* We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well\-being and inclusion are more than just words
* As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see

new_jobs.title: Director, Treasury Finance
new_jobs.description:
The primary responsibility of the Director is to lead Treasury Finance activities relating to corporate finance strategy, funding strategy, capital structure management, liability management, banking relationships, and capital markets execution. The Director serves as a key advisor to Treasury leadership and business partners on matters relating to funding, leverage, capital deployment, liquidity resources, and balance sheet optimization.

  

  

The role is accountable for developing and executing funding strategies that support Manulife's financial objectives while maintaining appropriate financial flexibility, regulatory capital levels, liquidity resources, and access to global capital markets. You will also be responsible for maintaining strong relationships with banking partners, investors, rating agencies, and advisors, while ensuring treasury financing activities are executed efficiently, effectively, and in accordance with approved governance frameworks.

  

  

**Position Responsibilities:**


* Act as Treasury Finance advisor with an overall mandate to support Treasury leadership, Capital Management, Investor Relations, Treasury Operations, Manulife Bank and other stakeholders through strategic analysis, funding recommendations, and corporate finance expertise.
* Develop recommendations regarding capital structure, leverage, funding strategy, refinancing, capital deployment, and balance sheet optimization to support the Company's financial objectives.
* Lead the development and ongoing assessment of funding strategies, incorporating market conditions, regulatory and rating agency considerations, funding requirements, investor demand, and competitive developments.
* Serve as the primary Treasury Finance lead for debt issuances, liability management transactions, wholesale funding programs, share repurchase initiatives, and other treasury\-related financing activities, including strategy, analysis, execution and post\-transaction review.
* Lead and manage Treasury\-owned banking relationships, including revolving credit facilities, letters of credit and other financing arrangements, and negotiate pricing, terms, capacity, documentation and service levels.
* Lead complex commercial negotiations with banking partners, dealers, investors, legal counsel and other external stakeholders. Review, analyze and negotiate credit agreements, underwriting agreements, term sheets, offering documents, trust indentures and other financing\-related documentation.
* Support and influence strategic decision\-making through the preparation of financial analysis, funding plans, capital structure assessments, Board materials, executive presentations and other management reporting.
* Lead strategic initiatives impacting Treasury Finance, including evaluating alternatives, assessing risks and opportunities, coordinating stakeholders and supporting implementation.
* Maintain relationships with banking partners, fixed income investors, rating agencies and other market participants to monitor trends, identify opportunities and support continued access to capital.
* Ensure funding instruments remain compliant with contractual, regulatory, reporting and governance requirements, including ongoing monitoring of covenants, obligations and maturity profiles.
* Identify and implement process improvements related to treasury strategy, funding activities, governance, reporting, controls and transaction execution.
* Responsible for coaching, mentoring and development of staff supporting Treasury Finance activities.
  

  

**Required Qualifications:**


* Post\-secondary education in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related discipline and/or a minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in treasury, corporate finance, capital markets, commercial banking, investment banking, insurance finance or a related field.
* Strong knowledge of corporate finance, capital structure management, leverage analysis, capital allocation, liquidity management and balance sheet optimization.
* Strong understanding of debt and equity capital markets, funding strategies, banking products, credit facilities and liability management activities.
* Experience executing complex financing transactions and negotiating commercial arrangements with financial institutions and other counterparties.
* Ability to review, understand and negotiate financing documentation, including credit agreements, underwriting agreements, term sheets, offering documents and related contracts.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to evaluate strategic alternatives and develop actionable recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Thorough understanding of risk management, governance and controls as they relate to treasury and financing activities.
* Excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills, including the ability to work effectively with senior management and executive stakeholders.
* Strong project management, organizational and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Demonstrated leadership capabilities with experience managing change, developing talent and fostering high\-performing teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work under pressure and adapt to changing business requirements.
* Capital markets, commercial banking, investment banking, treasury or corporate finance experience within a financial institution is considered a strong asset.

* We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want
* We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well\-being and inclusion are more than just words
* As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see
